The regulation gives no cord dimension. Aiguillette parts (loop, whipping, thin cord, pencil tip) are drawn as the overlay's own groups: proportions in braid thicknesses B (0.36 in here) from Vanguard SKU 3710210 (assets/cords/ref/README.md): free loop 5.9 x 4.7 B outer = 2.1 x 1.7 in, an oval with its inner edge on the run, whipping 0.9 x 2.6 B, thin cord 3.9 B long and 0.14 B thick, pencil tip 1.2 in (4.1 B at the 0.30 in braid of cord-aide-de-camp), so the tip point hangs about 4.0 in below the contact point.
